about: Rules that read differently in Flutter. The lines replace the common ones; the examples are in Dart.

focus-visible.build: Wrap custom focusable widgets in Focus or FocusableActionDetector and draw a visible focus decoration from the Theme; keep the traversal order with FocusTraversalGroup.
focus-visible.review: On a build that accepts a keyboard (web, desktop, a connected keyboard), tab through the screen: each focused widget shows a visible decoration.

examples.good: FocusableActionDetector(onShowFocusHighlight: (v) => setState(() => focused = v), child: DecoratedBox(decoration: BoxDecoration(border: focused ? Border.all(width: 2, color: scheme.primary) : null), child: child))
examples.bad: GestureDetector(onTap: open, child: Text('Open'))  // no focus, no highlight

accessible-name.build: Give every icon-only control a tooltip or a Semantics label in the language of the product; wrap a tappable custom widget in Semantics(button: true).
accessible-name.review: Each IconButton has a tooltip or a label; a GestureDetector around a custom widget has Semantics with the button role.

examples.good: IconButton(tooltip: 'Close menu', icon: const Icon(Icons.close), onPressed: close)
Semantics(button: true, label: 'Add to cart', child: GestureDetector(onTap: add, child: const CartIcon()))

readable-text-size.build: Take text styles from Theme.of(context).textTheme and let the system text scale apply; never fix a height that a larger text would overflow.
readable-text-size.review: Set the system text size to the largest and open the screen: text is larger and nothing overflows or is clipped.

examples.good: final scaler = MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context); final height = scaler.scale(14) + 24;
examples.bad: SizedBox(height: 40, child: Text(label))  // clips at a larger text size

form-labels.build: Give each TextField a labelText, which stays visible, and use hintText only as a hint; group fields in a Form with validators.
form-labels.review: Each TextField has a labelText; a field with only a hintText fails.

no-double-submit.build: Set onPressed to null while the request runs and show a progress indicator in the button.
no-double-submit.review: Tap the submit button twice quickly: the second tap does nothing and the button shows progress.

examples.good: FilledButton(onPressed: loading ? null : save, child: loading ? const SizedBox.square(dimension: 18, child: CircularProgressIndicator(strokeWidth: 2)) : const Text('Save'))
examples.bad: FilledButton(onPressed: save, child: const Text('Save'))  // stays active while loading

loading-indicators.build: Handle the waiting, error and data states of the future or stream; keep the final size of the content with a placeholder.
loading-indicators.review: Delay the data: a placeholder of the final size shows, then the content; an error shows an error state.

target-size-touch.build: Keep the minimum interactive size of the platform (48 dp); enlarge the hit area of a small icon with padding or constraints instead of shrinking the target.
target-size-touch.review: Measure the smallest tappable widget: none is smaller than 48 dp on Android or 44 pt on iOS.

examples.good: IconButton(constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 48, minHeight: 48), icon: const Icon(Icons.edit, size: 20), onPressed: edit)
examples.bad: SizedBox(width: 24, height: 24, child: InkWell(onTap: edit, child: const Icon(Icons.edit)))

errors-announced.build: Show the error in the field's errorText, which is announced with the field, or wrap a message that appears alone in Semantics(liveRegion: true).
errors-announced.review: With the screen reader on, an invalid field announces its error text.

examples.good: TextFormField(validator: (v) => v == null || v.isEmpty ? 'Enter an email address' : null)
examples.bad: Text('Enter an email address', style: TextStyle(color: Colors.red))  // not tied to the field

stable-layout.build: Reserve the size of content that loads later with an AspectRatio or a SizedBox of the final size.
stable-layout.review: Throttle the data: content around the late item does not move when it arrives.

examples.bad: Image.network(url)  // the height is unknown until it loads
